meaning: Leakage error: the washer has detected a water leak inside the appliance and its anti-flood safety switch has been activated.
diySteps: LG notes the washer has a safety mechanism to prevent flooding the floor: when water leaks, the safety switch is activated
Check the inlet hoses for loose connections or cuts
Unplug the washer, wait 60 seconds and restart it
safetyNote: Unplug the washer (or switch off its breaker) and close the water taps before you reach behind it, handle hoses or open a filter. Water left from a recent hot cycle can be very hot, so let it cool first. Never bypass the door lock. Motor, pump, valve, sensor and control-board repairs belong to a qualified appliance technician.
proAdvice: If AE persists after you check the inlet hoses and restart the washer, LG says to schedule a service request.
